recommendations.title: Energy demand substantially above recent pattern
recommendations.action: Review the current/upcoming high-demand period and operating schedule for avoidable load.
recommendations.reason: Consumption is +42.9% above the trailing 24-hour reference mean, above the 40.9% historical 98th-percentile threshold.
recommendations.confidence_basis: Rule confidence based on how far the observed deviation exceeds its historical percentile threshold. NOT a statistical probability that this recommendation is correct.
limitations: This dataset is public city-level power consumption, not industrial machine energy data - this recommendation concerns aggregate demand, not a specific machine's efficiency.
Elevated demand is a pattern deviation, not confirmed avoidable waste.
